text:
anya: quick alert - EU edge warm pool down ~35% in last 10m. Nodes failing at keystore decrypt, AccessDenied from keystore-proxy.

sam: sample boot log: `2026-03-22T12:00:12Z node-301 keystore decrypt: AccessDeniedException caller not authorized for Decrypt requestId=xyz-000 region=eu-west-1`

julien: any IAM/KMS policy pushes recently?

security-bot: CloudTrail shows policy change 7m before failures: change ct-2026-03-22-999 altered `aws:RequestTag/ephemeral` condition. Link: https://cloudtrail.example/org/ct-2026-03-22-999

lee: cost note - cross-region fallback (move ~30% load to us-west) adds egress/NAT + KMS cross-region calls, rough ~$6k/mo + burst NAT ~$1k/day.

sam: keystore-proxy logs show 403s with reason "iam condition failed" referencing ct-2026-03-22-999.

anya: proposal: short timeboxed IAM exception (20m) scoped to edge-join role + patch keystore-proxy to retry on 403s. Canary before full roll.

julien: will prepare Terraform diff (INFRA-4640), require 2 approvers, won't apply until canary green.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://internal.runbooks/keystore-boot step 2b.

sam: pushed retry patch to staging, 2-node canary shows retries succeed. Scaling to 10 nodes pending approval.

anya: once exception applied, scale to 20 -> roll to warm pool. Monitor bootstrap metrics & audit qps. If qps spikes, consider temporary retention drop (30d->7d) for audit-sampler.

lee: will hold retention toggle until Sec sign-off; estimated savings ~$2k/day during spike.

julien: applied 20m exception in prod, auto-revoke scheduled. Link to CT export in INFRA-4640.

anya: warm pool recovering (+27 nodes), bootstrap OK. Postmortem items: policy diff, tagging failure root cause, keystore retry hard-fail, cost tradeoffs (reroute vs exception). I'll own follow-up doc.

sam: will collect CloudTrail bootstrap fails and upload to INFRA-4640.

anya: thanks team :thumbsup:
